original.reference: Renshaw TL, Long ACJ, Cook CR. (2015). Assessing adolescents’ positive psychological functioning at school: Development and validation of the Student Subjective Wellbeing Questionnaire. School Psychology Quarterly,30(4),534–552.
original.verified: Author-linked publisher preview abstract; online-first2014, issue2015

originalValidation.chinese: No validated Chinese item wording or local norm verified in this sourcepack. Independent draft must not be represented as validated. CSSWQ Chinese university evidence is a DIFFERENT scale and cannot be attached here.

scoring.mean: sum divided by number of items; 4 for each subscale,16 for total
scoring.missing: Require all16 for report; no imputation. Conservative implementation rule, not validated author missingness algorithm.

interpretation.guide_evidence: 2020 guide explicitly reports no large-scale normative data; recommends local norming. It supports response-anchor interpretation: subscale8/4=2 means sometimes; total56/16=3.5 means often to almost always.
interpretation.between_anchors: Report between adjacent response anchors without rounding to a new severity category; e.g. 2.5 means 在“有时”和“经常”之间. These are descriptive response frequencies, not empirical clinical thresholds.
